terra.title: Terra: parcel freshness, API delivery and ownership intelligence

developments.source_fact: Regrid reports 48,648,877 parcels refreshed across 419 counties, average parcel age down to 114 days, and 95,058 new parcels. API 2.0 adds faster responses, usage reporting, filtering, alerts and limits.
developments.product_inference: Prioritize source-age and county-coverage fields, then expose provider usage limits before adding distressed-asset joins.

opportunities.title: Terra source-freshness adapter
opportunities.proposal: Add provider-aware freshness and quota metadata to each parcel or ownership result.
acceptance_criteria: County and retrieval dates are returned
Quota or rate-limit state is visible

sources.title: OFAC alert on Iranian shadow-fleet false flags

developments.source_fact: OFAC warned that vessels using fraudulent registries or false flags create sanctions and insurance risk, alongside designations tied to a maritime fraud network.
developments.product_inference: Vessels screening should model registry legitimacy and certification provenance alongside IMO, MMSI, ownership and AIS history.

opportunities.title: False-flag provenance gate
opportunities.proposal: Add a reviewable registry and certification provenance signal to maritime screening.
acceptance_criteria: No stale record is emitted as clear

sentra.title: Sentra/Aegis: SI incident governance and defensive readiness

sources.title: NIST IR 8621: SI incident management workshop findings

developments.source_fact: NIST published IR 8621 on incident-management challenges for super-intelligence systems, including cyberattacks, misuse, malfunction and unintended actions.
developments.product_inference: Extend Sentra incident states with explicit misuse, malfunction and unintended-action categories while preserving defensive scope.

opportunities.title: SI incident taxonomy
opportunities.proposal: Add defensive incident categories and handoff fields for AI-system misuse and malfunction.
acceptance_criteria: Each category has a detection source
Human approval remains required for response
Test fixtures cover unknown and unavailable states

lyte.title: Lyte: OpenTelemetry JS 3.0 and telemetry compatibility

developments.source_fact: OpenTelemetry JS SDK 3.0 is stable, raises minimum Node.js to 22.15, and stabilizes logs alongside traces and metrics.
developments.product_inference: Lyte should treat SDK and runtime compatibility as a versioned telemetry contract, especially for Node 18/20 estates.

opportunities.title: Telemetry compatibility gate
opportunities.proposal: Add a Node/runtime and signal-availability matrix to Lyte ingestion readiness.
acceptance_criteria: Trace, metric and log support is explicit

counsel.title: PRISM Counsel: AI governance and legal-intelligence implications

sources.title: DOJ launches Super Intelligence Task Force

developments.source_fact: The DOJ announced a Super Intelligence Task Force focused on misuse, unlawful conduct, reporting on SI risk and internal controls.
developments.product_inference: PRISM matter intelligence can track AI-governance authorities, obligations and evidence without treating policy announcements as deadlines.

opportunities.title: AI-governance matter template
opportunities.proposal: Add authority, obligation, evidence and deadline fields for AI-governance matters.
acceptance_criteria: Authority date and jurisdiction are stored
Policy text is separated from legal advice
